metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the book, forty shillings, and the speech written sitting down.

yesterday: Sixpence. You said nothing at the stall. You copied one sentence, ruled a line under it, and wrote no answer. You claimed no kinship.
Forty shillings. Last Saturday was eight-and-twenty. The spring's best. The chest was not counted. Nothing of the lease was agreed.
Done above: the landing, and the greeting of the earth. The speech came whole. You sat.
Then Flint, and a king coming down. The page ends there. At one you said you would not write better this year, and then you told yourself not to say it.
